title: South Korea moves to block 27 crypto websites, including KuCoin, MEXC
summary: Authorities said the restrictions are aimed at unregistered exchanges and have acknowledged that customers could have difficulty withdrawing assets.
content: South Korea is moving to block 27 cryptocurrency websites, including major exchanges like KuCoin and MEXC. Authorities announced that these restrictions specifically target unregistered exchanges operating in the region. Officials have acknowledged that customers using these platforms may experience difficulties when attempting to withdraw their digital assets.
content_ta: பதிவு செய்யப்படாத KuCoin மற்றும் MEXC உள்ளிட்ட 27 கிரிப்டோகரன்சி வலைத்தளங்களை முடக்க தென் கொரியா நடவடிக்கை எடுத்து வருகிறது. இந்த கட்டுப்பாடுகள் இப்பகுதியில் இயங்கும் பதிவு செய்யப்படாத பரிமாற்றங்களை குறிவைத்துள்ளதாக அதிகாரிகள் அறிவித்துள்ளனர். இந்த தளங்களைப் பயன்படுத்தும் வாடிக்கையாளர்கள் தங்கள் டிஜிட்டல் சொத்துக்களை திரும்பப் பெறுவதில் சிரமங்களை எதிர்கொள்ளக்கூடும் என்பதை அதிகாரிகள் ஒப்புக்கொண்டுள்ளனர்.

title: Aptos rolls out Encrypted Mempool to curb frontrunning, sandwich attacks
summary: The optional feature hides transaction details until their order is finalized, preventing bots from exploiting pending trades.
content: Aptos has introduced a new optional Encrypted Mempool feature designed to prevent frontrunning and sandwich attacks. By hiding transaction details until their final order is established, this update stops automated bots from exploiting pending trades on the network, ultimately creating a fairer trading environment for all users.
content_ta: frontrunning மற்றும் sandwich attacks-ஐ தடுப்பதற்காக Aptos புதிய Encrypted Mempool அம்சத்தை அறிமுகப்படுத்தியுள்ளது. பரிவர்த்தனை விவரங்களை இறுதி வரிசைப்படுத்தல் வரை மறைத்து வைப்பதன் மூலம், நிலுவையில் உள்ள வர்த்தகங்களை பொட்கள் (bots) தவறாகப் பயன்படுத்துவதை இந்த அம்சம் தடுக்கிறது.

title: Internet Computer just broke out of its descending triangle – And whales noticed

content_ta: Nvidia சிப்ஸ்களிலிருந்து விலகிச் செல்லும்படி தனது நாட்டின் டெக் நிறுவனங்களை ஒப்புவிக்க சீனா சிரமங்களை எதிர்கொண்டுள்ளது. சீனாவின் இந்த முயற்சி செமிகண்டக்டர் துறையில் தன்னிறவடைவதற்கான சவால்களை வெளிச்சம் போட்டுக் காட்டுகிறது. இந்த நடவடிக்கைகள் உலகளாவிய சப்ளை செயின்களை மாற்றியமைப்பதோடு, Nvidia நிறுவனத்தின் சந்தை வியூகத்தையும் லாபத்தையும் பாதிக்கலாம்.

title: Saudi Arabia’s warning system failure precedes deadly Riyadh airport attacks
summary:
The failure highlights vulnerabilities in Saudi security, potentially leading to increased airspace restrictions and impacting regional stability.
The post Saudi Arabia’s warning system failure precedes deadly Riyadh airport attacks appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: A failure in Saudi Arabia’s warning system preceded deadly attacks at the Riyadh airport. This security breach highlights significant vulnerabilities in the nation's defense infrastructure, potentially resulting in heightened airspace restrictions and broader implications for regional stability.
content_ta: Saudi Arabia-ன் எச்சரிக்கை அமைப்பு தோல்வியடைந்ததைத் தொடர்ந்து Riyadh விமான நிலையத்தில் கொடூர தாக்குதல்கள் நடந்துள்ளன. இந்த பாதுகாப்பு குறைபாடு நாட்டின் பாதுகாப்பு கட்டமைப்பில் உள்ள பலவீனங்களை வெளிச்சம் போட்டுக் காட்டுகிறது, இது வான்வெளி கட்டுப்பாடுகள் அதிகரிக்க வழிவகுக்கலாம்.

title: XRP’s Rally Faces a Reality Check as Spot Trading Activity Dries Up
summary: XRP's price recovery has not revived spot trading. In fact, CryptoQuant data revealed that futures activity is dominating Binance's market by a significant margin.
content: XRP's recent price rally has encountered a reality check as spot trading activity dries up. According to CryptoQuant data, the recovery in XRP prices has failed to revive spot markets. Instead, futures trading activity continues to dominate the market on Binance by a significant margin, highlighting a reliance on derivatives.
content_ta: XRP-ன் விலை உயர்வு ஸ்பாட் வர்த்தகத்தின் வீழ்ச்சியால் சவால்களைச் சந்தித்து வருகிறது. CryptoQuant தரவுகளின்படி, XRP-ன் விலை மீட்சி ஸ்பாட் சந்தைகளை மீண்டும் உயிர்ப்பிக்கத் தவறிவிட்டது. அதற்கு பதிலாக, Binance-ல் ஃபியூச்சர்ஸ் வர்த்தக நடவடிக்கைகளே சந்தையில் பெருமளவில் ஆதிக்கம் செலுத்துகின்றன.

title: Can Hong Kong’s new Solana ETF reverse October’s weak fund demand?
summary: Solana’s Hong Kong ETF launch coincides with $3 billion in USDC supply and rising short liquidity, raising questions about a potential SOL bear trap.
content: Can Hong Kong's new Solana ETF reverse October's weak fund demand? The launch of the Solana ETF coincides with a large USDC supply increase and rising short liquidity, leaving analysts questioning whether the market is facing a potential bear trap for SOL.
content_ta: Hong Kong-ல் புதிதாக அறிமுகப்படுத்தப்பட்டுள்ள Solana ETF, அக்டோபர் மாதத்தின் பலவீனமான ஃபண்ட் தேவையை மாற்றி அமைக்க முடியுமா? இந்த Solana ETF அறிமுகமானது, அதிகரித்த USDC சப்ளை மற்றும் உயர்ந்த ஷார்ட் லிக்யூடிட்டி ஆகியவற்றுடன் இணைந்துள்ளது. இதனால் சந்தையானது SOL-க்கான ஒரு கரடி வலையை (bear trap) எதிர்கொள்கிறதா என்ற கேள்வியை இது எழுப்பியுள்ளது.

title: Citi Says S&P 500 Needs AI and Non-AI Stocks to Reach 8,100
summary:
Citi's Chronert says the S&P 500 needs AI and rate-sensitive stocks to both rally to reach 8,100 as earnings season starts.
The post Citi Says S&P 500 Needs AI and Non-AI Stocks to Reach 8,100 appeared first on BeInCrypto.
content: Citi strategist Chronert stated that the S&P 500 requires both artificial intelligence and rate-sensitive, non-AI stocks to rally together in order to reach the milestone of 8,100 as the new earnings season begins. The outlook emphasizes broader market participation beyond just technology sectors to achieve future growth targets.
content_ta: Citi-ன் strategist Chronert வெளியிட்டுள்ள அறிக்கையில், S&P 500 குறியீடு 8,100 என்ற மைல்கல்லை எட்ட வேண்டுமெனில், AI பங்குகளுடன் சேர்த்து வட்டி விகித உணர்திறன் கொண்ட மற்ற பங்குகளும் இணைந்து உயர வேண்டும் என்று குறிப்பிட்டுள்ளார். புதிய வருவாய் பருவம் தொடங்கும் நிலையில், தொழில்நுட்பத் துறையைத் தாண்டி சந்தையின் பிற பகுதிகளிலும் வளர்ச்சி இருக்க வேண்டியது அவசியம் என்பதை இந்தச் செய்தி வலியுறுத்துகிறது.

title: Vitalik Buterin says public-key cryptography may need one or two more upgrades
summary:
The potential need for cryptographic upgrades highlights the ongoing challenge of securing digital communications against evolving AI threats.
The post Vitalik Buterin says public-key cryptography may need one or two more upgrades appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Ethereum co-founder Vitalik Buterin recently stated that public-key cryptography could require one or two additional upgrades in the future. This potential need for cryptographic enhancements underscores the continuous challenge of securing digital communications against emerging technological and artificial intelligence threats.
content_ta: Ethereum co-founder Vitalik Buterin, public-key cryptography எதிர்காலத்தில் ஒன்று அல்லது இரண்டு மேம்படுத்தல்களைச் சந்திக்க வேண்டியிருக்கலாம் என்று தெரிவித்துள்ளார். வளர்ந்து வரும் தொழில்நுட்ப மற்றும் AI அச்சுறுத்தல்களுக்கு எதிராக டிஜிட்டல் தகவல்தொடர்புகளைப் பாதுகாப்பதில் உள்ள தொடர்ச்சியான சவால்களை இந்த அவசியமான மேம்படுத்தல்கள் சுட்டிக்காட்டுகின்றன.

title: UK crypto trader robbed of about $800,000 in violent home invasion
summary:
The incident highlights the growing risks of crypto ownership, emphasizing the need for enhanced security measures and regulatory oversight.
The post UK crypto trader robbed of about $800,000 in violent home invasion appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: A UK crypto trader was targeted in a violent home invasion, resulting in the theft of approximately $800,000 worth of cryptocurrency. This disturbing incident underscores the rising physical and digital security risks faced by digital asset holders. Industry observers emphasize that such crimes highlight an urgent need for enhanced personal security protocols and greater regulatory oversight to protect cryptocurrency investors.
content_ta: UK-ஐச் சேர்ந்த ஒரு crypto வர்த்தகரின் வீட்டில் நிகழ்ந்த வன்முறைத் தாக்குதலில் தோராயமாக $800,000 மதிப்புள்ள cryptocurrency கொள்ளையடிக்கப்பட்டது. இந்தச் சம்பவம் டிஜிட்டல் சொத்து வைத்திருப்பவர்கள் எதிர்கொள்ளும் அதிகரித்து வரும் பாதுகாப்பு அபாயங்களை வெளிச்சம் போட்டுக் காட்டுகிறது. முதலீட்டாளர்களைப் பாதுகாக்க மேம்பட்ட பாதுகாப்பு முறைகளும் ஒழுங்குமுறை மேற்பார்வையும் அவசியமாகிறது என்பதை இது வலியுறுத்துகிறது.

title: IMF’s Vamvakidis warns an AI market correction could spill over into the real economy, depending on its severity

An AI market correction could significantly impact global economic stability, affecting investment confidence and economic output projections.

content: IMF official Vamvakidis has warned that a potential correction in the artificial intelligence market could spill over into the broader real economy. The severity of this impact will depend largely on how deep the market correction is. Experts note this could affect overall investment confidence and future economic output projections on a global scale.
content_ta: IMF அதிகாரியான Vamvakidis, ஆர்டிஃபிஷியல் இன்டெலிஜென்ஸ் சந்தையில் ஏற்படும் சாத்தியமான சரிவு உண்மையான பொருளாதாரத்திற்கும் பரவக்கூடும் என்று எச்சரித்துள்ளார். இந்த தாக்கத்தின் தீவிரமானது சந்தை சரிவின் ஆழத்தைப் பொறுத்தே அமையும். இது உலகளாவிய அளவில் முதலீட்டு நம்பிக்கையையும் எதிர்கால பொருளாதார வெளியீட்டு கணிப்புகளையும் பாதிக்கலாம் என்று நிபுணர்கள் குறிப்பிடுகின்றனர்.

title: Chip stocks slide as fears mount over AI investment scale

content: Chip stocks experienced a notable decline amid growing concerns over the scale of AI investments. This market dip underscores the tech sector's sensitivity to changing sentiment regarding artificial intelligence funding and financing limitations, according to reports by Crypto Briefing.

title: KOSPI Index Today: Why Samsung’s 17% Five-Day Slide Is Dragging South Korea’s Market
summary:
The post KOSPI Index Today: Why Samsung’s 17% Five-Day Slide Is Dragging South Korea’s Market appeared first on Coinpedia Fintech News
South Korea’s KOSPI fell as much as 6.1% to near 5,996, its fifth straight daily loss and a drop of more than 15% in five sessions, leaving it roughly 35% below its June record high. This marked the fifth consecutive daily loss for the market, driven heavily by a sharp slide in memory stocks. title: Tokenized SanDisk bets saw more liquidations than XRP as Asia’s chip rout wipes out $800 million
summary: About $800 million in leveraged positions were wiped out over 24 hours, 86% of them bullish. Chip-stock contracts on crypto exchanges took a chunk of the damage.
content: A sharp market downturn in Asia wiped out about $800 million in leveraged positions within 24 hours, with 86% of those liquidations being bullish bets. Chip-stock related contracts on crypto exchanges suffered heavy losses. Notably, tokenized SanDisk bets recorded more liquidations than XRP amid the broader regional semiconductor rout.
content_ta: ஆசியாவில் ஏற்பட்ட திடீர் சந்தை சரிவு காரணமாக 24 மணி நேரத்திற்குள் சுமார் $800 மில்லியன் அளவிலான லீவரேஜ் செய்யப்பட்ட பொசிஷன்கள் அழிக்கப்பட்டன. இதில் 86% லாபகரமான பந்தயங்களாகும். கிரிப்டோ எக்ஸ்சேஞ்சுகளில் உள்ள சிப்-ஸ்டாக் தொடர்பான ஒப்பந்தங்கள் பெரும் இழப்புகளை சந்தித்தன. குறிப்பாக, பிராந்திய அளவிலான செமிக்கண்டக்டர் சரிவுக்கு மத்தியில், XRP-ஐ விட டோக்கனைஸ்டு SanDisk பந்தயங்கள் அதிக லிக்யிடேஷன்களை பதிவு செய்தன.

title: Bitcoin rebounds above $83,000 as it decouples from tumbling Korean stocks and Nasdaq futures
summary: Bitcoin climbed back above $83,000 after an early dip, decoupling from a sharp slide in Korean chip stocks and weakness in Nasdaq futures ahead of Thursday’s US CPI report.
content: Bitcoin climbed back above $83,000 following an early market dip. The cryptocurrency successfully decoupled from a sharp slide in Korean chip stocks and ongoing weakness in Nasdaq futures. This price recovery occurred as investors and traders positioned themselves ahead of the upcoming United States Consumer Price Index report scheduled for release on Thursday.
content_ta: Bitcoin ஆரம்பகட்ட சரிவிலிருந்து மீண்டு மீண்டும் $83,000 விலையைக் கடந்தது. கொரிய சிப் பங்குகளின் சரிவு மற்றும் Nasdaq ஃபியூச்சர்களின் பலவீனத்திலிருந்து இந்த கிரிப்டோகரன்சி விலகியுள்ளது. வியாழக்கிழமை வெளியாகவுள்ள United States CPI அறிக்கைக்கு முன்னதாக இந்த விலை உயர்வு ஏற்பட்டுள்ளது.

title: Blur is shutting down its website, so why are NFT collectors cheering?
summary: Blur’s planned website closure revived criticism of the royalty policies and token rewards that helped it overtake OpenSea during the NFT boom, but hurt creators.
content: NFT marketplace Blur is shutting down its website, prompting mixed reactions from collectors and creators. While the closure has sparked celebrations among some collectors, it also renewed heavy criticism over the platform's past token rewards and royalty policies. These controversial policies previously helped Blur surpass OpenSea during the height of the NFT boom, but many creators argue that the platform's practices ultimately harmed creators.
content_ta: NFT மார்ட் ஆபரேட்டரான Blur தனது வலைத்தளத்தை மூடுவதாக அறிவித்துள்ளது. இது கலெக்டர்கள் மற்றும் கிரியேட்டர்கள் மத்தியில் பல்வேறு எதிர்வினைகளை ஏற்படுத்தியுள்ளது. இந்த நடவடிக்கை சில கலெக்டர்களிடையே மகிழ்ச்சியை ஏற்படுத்தியிருந்தாலும், பிளாட்ஃபார்மின் பழைய டோக்கன் வெகுமதிகள் மற்றும் ராயல்டி கொள்கைகள் குறித்த கடுமையான விமர்சனங்களை மீண்டும் எழுப்பியுள்ளது. NFT ஏற்றத்தின் போது OpenSea-வை விஞ்ச Blur-க்கு இந்தக் கொள்கைகள் உதவின, ஆனால் கிரியேட்டர்களை இது பாதித்ததாகக் கூறப்படுகின்றது.

title: Hadrian Raises $40M to Tackle the AI Hacking Cybersecurity Crisis
summary:
Hadrian, the agentic AI offensive security platform, today announced a $40 million funding round co-led by Forgepoint Capital International and SmartFin, with participation from existing investors HV Capital, Motive Partners, Picus Capital and Oetker Ventures. The backing brings total funding to $65M and will fund expansion across EMEA and the U.S. and deepen investment in Hadrian's engineering and research teams. 
The raise comes as AI fundamentally upends the offensive security landscape. News of AI agents escaping test environments and hacking company systems with no human direction have dominated headlines in recent weeks. In the most recent, Anthropic disclosed that criminals and state-linked groups had used its models to automate whole attack chains and write zero-day exploits. Attackers now move at machine speed, but many security teams are years behind, with data showing that 87% of organizations still run manual pentests. 
They are also being distracted by the volume of irrelevant signals: more than 70% of security teams struggle to determine which exposures are exploitable, unsurprising when only 0.47% of vulnerability scanner findings proved genuinely exploitable. That means 99.5% of the alerts teams focus on need no action. 
As such, there is a real market need for a solution that can identify the genuine threats and cut through the noise. Hadrian allows businesses to see security through a hacker’s eyes, mapping the digital footprint, discover risks, and prioritise remediation for security teams to harden their external attack surfaces. Humans set the mission and make the decisions that matter, while AI does the work in between, providing the coverage, repetition and speed that no team can sustain around the clock.
To achieve this, Hadrian combines continuous exposure management and agentic penetration testing in one platform, the only vendor to offer this approach. Atlas continuously maps an organization’s external attack surface and uses purpose-built AI agents to validate which exposures are actually exploitable. Nova provides agentic pentesting on demand on a human-pentest level and beyond. Together, they deliver results that include: 
10x greater visibility into critical exposures
80% faster time to resolution
5x ROI compared to manual pentesting
Because the two share context, security teams can move from continuous visibility to deeper testing without starting from scratch.
Hadrian was founded by Rogier Fischer, Olivier Beg and Maurice Clin. Fischer and Beg are former teenage ethical hackers turned serial entrepreneurs, with Fischer launching one of Europe’s first crypto-exchanges before working with Beg on Hadrian. They built the company to create offensive security that could operate continuously and at scale, giving teams more reach without taking judgment out of their hands.
Rogier Fischer, CEO of Hadrian, said: “Everyone can see that AI is changing the threat landscape. It might also hold the answer, but most people are focused on automating the wrong bits. We have been working with LLMs since before they went mainstream, and we know that AI can work much faster than any human offensive security team. So we built a platform that emulates hackers’ attack paths, helping our customers to understand their key risks and prioritise their security resources appropriately.”
Damien Henault, Managing Director and Partner at Forgepoint Capital International, said: “There are too many vulnerabilities and noise out there for teams to manage, so they need tools that can help them see clearly and think like AI-armed hackers. Hadrian’s AI native always-on solution delivers both depth and breadth and helps its customers to focus on genuine issues and risks, and the companies using its platform are testament to both its innovative approach and the strength of its team, both aspects which make them a natural choice for us to back.” 
Saumitra Dubey, Partner at SmartFin, said: “Rogier and his team have built an agentic hacking platform that truly stands apart in the offensive cybersecurity space. Hadrian’s growing enterprise contract values, global customer base and exceptional enterprise retention rates demonstrate both the strength of its product and the team’s ability to execute and win against the largest cybersecurity incumbents. This funding comes at a pivotal moment, accelerating Hadrian’s next phase of growth as we support its ambition to become a global cybersecurity leader and build a nine-figure revenue business.”
Hadrian works with companies in the US and Europe, including Fortune 500 leaders and industry disruptors such as McKesson, NBC Universal, Francisco Partners, Total Energies, Amadeus, Leroy Merlin, and Damen Shipyard. 
Alessio Setaro, Digital Solutions Leader at Leroy Merlin said: “Leroy Merlin runs large omnichannel operations, and every new solution and digital integration adds to what we have to protect. Hadrian helps us to find exposed assets when they run out our control and test them the way an attacker would. That gave our team clear priorities. We're glad to see Hadrian raise this round and keep building.” 
Hans Quivooij, CISO at Damen Shipyards said: “Hadrian has changed the way we look at our external attack surface. Instead of relying on periodic assessments and a known inventory, we now have continuous visibility into what an attacker can actually see and potentially exploit. For a global organisation like Damen, that ability to discover unknown exposures and focus our teams on the risks that really matter is where Hadrian delivers its value.”

title: M-KOPA Reaches 10 Million Customers Across 5 Markets
summary:
M-KOPA, the pan-African fintech, has reached 10 million customers across its 5 African markets. From its first solar sale in 2012, reaching 1 million customers took 8 years. Since its entry into smartphone financing in 2020, M-KOPA has added 9 million more in just 6 years, a marked acceleration in customer growth.
The milestone reflects growing demand for M-KOPA's "More than a Phone" platform, which combines smartphone financing with embedded insurance, credit and device protection at the point of purchase.
M-KOPA was built for what it calls "Every Day Earners": the traders, boda riders, tailors and shopkeepers who generate income daily but remain invisible to conventional financial services. Where traditional banks saw only risk, M-KOPA saw an opportunity to provide an economically active population with innovative products and services designed around daily livelihoods.  9 in 10 independently surveyed M-KOPA customers say  that M-KOPA products have improved their lives.
"Every Day Earners have always been creditworthy. What they needed was credit built around how they really make a living, not a payslip. Informal has never meant unviable. 10 million customers on, that's no longer a belief. It's proven," said Jesse Moore, Co-Founder and CEO of M-KOPA.\

The addressable opportunity remains vast. Nearly 9 in 10 workers in sub-Saharan Africa earn their living in the informal economy. By 2040, Africa is projected to have among the largest populations of non-salaried, economically active adults in the world, the core market M-KOPA is built to serve.
In Kenya, the company opened the continent’s largest smartphone assembly factory in 2023, which employs over 400 people, has achieved global ISO-certification, and has produced over 3.3 million devices to date.
Growth beyond East Africa has accelerated too: Nigeria became the fastest market in M-KOPA's history to surpass 1 million customers. The company's reach is carried by Africa's largest direct sales distribution network, with more than 40,000 agents across five countries.
The company’s revenue has grown at an average annual rate of 50% per year since 2020. That performance has been recognised externally, as M-KOPA has been named to the Financial Times' Africa's Fastest Growing Companies list for five consecutive years, and to CNBC's World's Top Fintech Companies for the second consecutive year.
“Every Day Earners are why we do this. From our very first customer to this year's ten millionth, this is proof that a model built for Africa's Every Day Earners doesn't just work, it scales and endures. It's a proud moment for our team, and we're already looking to the next 10  million"  said M-KOPA CFO Faraimose Kutadzaushe.

title: Arvin Razon Joins Armalytix as Head of Legal and Compliance
summary:
Armalytix has appointed Arvin Razon as its first dedicated Head of Legal and Compliance, a move that underpins the company’s ambition to be the trusted compliance infrastructure for the UK property sector as it scales across conveyancing, lending and estate agency, helping property professionals move transactions forward with confidence, and home movers complete their purchase with fewer delays.
The appointment comes as Armalytix deepens its regulatory footprint. As an FCA-registered Account Information Service Provider for seven years, the company has built a compliance framework that now needs to evolve in step with its growth across Open Banking, identity verification and Source of Funds products. Arvin’s arrival gives Armalytix a senior, dedicated voice on regulation and risk, freeing the business to move faster for clients while deepening the trust conveyancers, lenders and brokers place in its platform.
Arvin brings more than ten years of experience building and leading legal and compliance functions across Open Banking, payments and fintech. He is a qualified solicitor in England and Wales, also qualified to practise in Australia and the Philippines, and holds an MBA from the University of Cambridge (Judge Business School), a Master of Laws from the University of Melbourne, and a Juris Doctor from the University of the Philippines. He is a Fellow of Information Privacy with the International Association of Privacy Professionals, with further certifications in artificial intelligence governance, privacy management, US and European privacy law and cybersecurity.
He joins from senior legal and compliance leadership roles at Paddle, Thought Machine, Brankas and ING Bank, having served as Data Protection Officer across all his previous roles. title: FC Bayern München Extends Partnership with Adyen: 10% More Transactions and a 3-Second Faster Checkout
summary:
Adyen, the global financial technology platform of choice for leading businesses, is continuing its partnership with FC Bayern München, which began in 2023. The German record champion is extending the collaboration to further develop payment processes at the Allianz Arena and in global e-commerce together with Adyen.
The switch to Adyen’s platform reduced the average processing time per payment transaction at the stadium from 30 to 27 seconds. This time savings of three seconds per transaction enables the club and its catering partner, DO & CO, to process approximately 10 % more kiosk transactions on match days at the Allianz Arena, which attracts up to 75,000 visitors—particularly during the heavily trafficked 15-minute halftime break.
A Unified Payment Infrastructure for Fans Worldwide
As a unified commerce partner, Adyen consolidates all of FC Bayern München’s sales channels on a single central platform:
Use of mobile terminals in the stadium: The terminals used at the Allianz Arena can be managed centrally. Mobile all-in-one devices with standalone SIM cards enable catering teams and beer servers in the stands to process payments flexibly, independent of the stadium’s Wi-Fi. In the FC Bayern stores, mobile terminals and Tap to Pay reduce wait times.
International focus: In e-commerce, FC Bayern now offers its fans over 250 payment methods in more than 200 countries. During the Summer Tour in Asia, the tailored local payment methods led to triple-digit percentage growth in online sales in the respective markets. At the Allianz Arena, international guests can pay via Alipay+ using a QR code, among other options.
Donation feature at the terminal: Through Adyen Giving, fans can donate directly at the terminal to FC Bayern Hilfe e.V., the club’s official non-profit charitable foundation. Since Adyen waives transaction fees, 100 %of the donations go to the organization, generating five-figure amounts on big game days.
“What matters in this partnership is this: The perfect stadium experience simply has to be fun for our fans. The payment process should run seamlessly and invisibly in the background,” said Rouven Kasper, FC Bayern’s Executive Board Member for Marketing & Sales. “Thanks to our partnership with Adyen, this is the case throughout our Allianz Arena as well as in our stores, among other places. Together, we form an extremely innovative team that sets global benchmarks and is constantly evolving. This benefits Adyen, FC Bayern München, and—above all—our fans in their day-to-day lives.”
“At major events, payment isn’t just a supporting player—it’s crucial to the fan experience,” said Hella Fuhrmann, Country Manager for Germany, Austria, and Switzerland at Adyen. “The extension of our partnership with FC Bayern München proves that our technology sets the standard for the entire live entertainment industry—when maximum performance runs in the background, it creates real added value for fans and event organizers.”

title: Dollar Accounts for Seven in Ten UK Client Payments Despite De-Dollarisation Talks, iBanFirst Data Shows
summary:
The US dollar accounted for 70% of international payments made by UK businesses using iBanFirst in the first half of 2026, according to the second edition of iBanFirst's Speed of International Payments barometer. The figure has not moved all that significantly since 2025, when it stood at 72%, according to the transaction data.
 
This matters because it leaves businesses more exposed to currency swings, especially as political talk about ditching the dollar gets louder. If a business hasn't locked in an exchange rate in advance, the pound cost of a dollar payment can move between agreeing the deal and the money actually landing, sometimes by thousands of pounds on a single transaction.
 
The dollar's share of payments was 16 percentage points higher among UK clients than across iBanFirst's European client base, where it stood at 54% over the same period. The gap was the same in 2025, when the UK figure was 72% compared with 56% in Europe. The findings reflect iBanFirst's own customer base rather than the wider UK business population, and measure the number of payments made, not their total value.
 
Why dollar use persists
 

"Dollar invoicing is often set by the supplier, not the buyer," said Vivek Savani, UK Country Manager at iBanFirst. "A UK business importing from Asia or the US is frequently just quoted in dollars. Changing that usually means renegotiating a supply contract, not just adjusting a payment instruction, which is why it doesn't happen quickly even when the political conversation has moved on."
 
"De-dollarisation is moving much faster in political rhetoric than in corporate behaviour," Savani added. "Commercial relationships and payment habits are much stickier than geopolitics."
 
Not every payment carries that risk equally. A business that has agreed an exchange rate in advance, through an FX forward payment for example, will not see the sterling cost of that payment move with the market. For a payment made at the prevailing GBP/USD exchange rate, a 1% movement over a day or two could change the sterling cost of a USD payment of $1 million by approximately £7,600. This is based on a GBP/USD rate of around 1.32 on 13 October 2026. 
 
20% of iBanFirst's UK clients use an FX forward payment to agree an exchange rate in advance for their underlying dollar payments. 
 
Where the dollar shows up most
 
USD to China and USD to Hong Kong were the UK's two most common payment corridors in the first half of 2026, together accounting for a quarter of UK outbound payments tracked (by number of payments, not value). Neither featured among the UK's six largest payment corridors in 2025, when the smallest of those six accounted for under 1% of payments.
 

These routes also tend to settle more slowly than payments to the US or within the UK, Savani said. "That's partly down to time zones, and partly down to the extra compliance and sanctions screening that payments into these corridors can attract. It's a separate question from currency risk, though, which depends on when a business fixes its exchange rate, not on how long the payment takes to clear."
 

Savani said the dollar's dominance in these routes is unlikely to disappear quickly, but it may not be permanent either. "We're already seeing some trade tensions push exporters towards settling in renminbi, though its share of global payments is still small," he said. "There are also central bank-backed platforms being built specifically to give Asian economies a way to settle trade without routing through the dollar. None of that changes the picture today, but it's worth UK businesses watching, especially those increasingly paying into these corridors."

title: NBB and TerraPay Partner to Connect Traditional Banking with the Global Digital Payments Ecosystem
summary:
The National Bank of Bahrain (NBB), a leading bank in Bahrain has entered into a strategic partnership with TerraPay, a global digital money movement company, to expand its international payout capabilities and enhance cross-border payment experiences for its customers. 
 
The collaboration combines NBB's established banking infrastructure, customer relationships and regional expertise with TerraPay's extensive digital global payout network. Through this partnership, NBB will leverage TerraPay's digital infrastructure to extend its international reach, simplify cross-border payout operations and enable access to a broader range of payment destinations. Central to this partnership is TerraPay's ability to receive Swift ISO 20022 messaging and seamlessly deliver cross border transactions in real-time safely and securely. All with the benefit of complete transparency to the customer with no deductions from the principal amount. 
 
Through TerraPay's strategic Swift connectivity, banks can leverage existing Swift infrastructure and established RMA key exchange processes to access TerraPay's network of bank accounts, digital wallets and local payment systems worldwide. This approach significantly reduces the complexity of direct integrations while enabling faster access to new markets and payout corridors. Through this collaboration with Swift, TerraPay enables banking partners such as NBB to concentrate on their core strengths: customer relationships, banking services and delivering an increasingly digital customer experience.
 
Commenting on the occasion, Vineet Munot, Group Head of Transaction Banking at NBB, said, “International connectivity is becoming increasingly important to how our customers operate, and our role is to ensure that NBB’s transaction banking expertise continues to serve those needs with speed and reliability. This collaboration is a strategic step forward in scaling our payments proposition through infrastructure that can improve the cross-border transaction experience. Through TerraPay, we see an opportunity to connect our customers in Bahrain and the region with a wider range of payment destinations, supporting their growth as their requirements become more global.” 
Ani Sane, Co-Founder and Chief Business Officer at TerraPay, said: “Banks want to extend their international payment reach without having to build and maintain separate connections into every market, wallet and local payment system. That is exactly the problem TerraPay solves. By combining TerraPay’s global payout network with Swift connectivity, NBB can use its existing banking infrastructure to access more than 12 billion bank accounts, digital wallets and local payment systems through a single global network. This partnership gives NBB a faster and more scalable way to expand into new corridors, broaden customer choice and improve the cross-border payment experience, while allowing the bank to retain control of the customer relationship and its core banking infrastructure. NBB is a strong example of how leading banks are choosing TerraPay to extend traditional correspondent banking into the rapidly growing world of instant payments and digital wallets.”
By bringing together NBB's established banking capabilities and TerraPay's global digital payout infrastructure, the two organisations aim to bridge traditional banking and emerging payment ecosystems, creating new opportunities for more accessible, efficient and connected crossborder money movement.

title: Banks Think They're Ready for Tomorrow's Fraud. Feedzai’s Survey Suggests Otherwise
summary:
Banks and fintechs are confident they're ready for the next wave of fraud, but the evidence suggests they're overestimating themselves.
In Feedzai’s latest research report, Confidence & Capability: The Feedzai Fraud Readiness Index 2026—which surveyed more than 1,000 senior fraud leaders across 12 countries—financial institutions rated their own fraud readiness at an average score of 80.2 out of 100. But when measured against their actual capabilities across data, AI, intelligence sharing, and fraud team operations, the average dropped to 66.9.
The 13.3-point gap indicates that while FIs recognize and are actively addressing the need for robust fraud capabilities to defend against AI-driven threats, intent and perception are not yet matching execution. Core improvement areas include better connecting data sources, deploying more mature AI tools like agents, and cutting down on time wasted via manual data collection.
Budgets don’t seem to be an obstacle to bridging this gap. Nearly every leader surveyed (96%) expects their budget for AI-powered fraud tools to grow over the next two years, but the basics are still slowing their fraud teams down:
73% say their analysts spend too much time manually pulling data from different systems instead of analyzing threats, the most consistent pain point in the report
Only 41% have fully connected data across their fraud, anti-money laundering, compliance, and cybersecurity teams
In practice, gaps like these mean that an analyst investigating a suspicious payment may have to check several separate systems before they can see the full picture of a customer. Every minute spent doing that is a minute not stopping fraud. 
The industry recognizes the need to work together to bridge these gaps. Fraudsters excel at intelligence sharing, and scams, where criminals trick customers into sending money themselves, are now the biggest source of fraud losses in 10 of the 12 countries surveyed.
That means that banks are responding in a way that would have been unthinkable a few years ago: 87% would consider securely sharing fraud intelligence with other institutions, including their direct competitors. 
"Banks aren't short on ambition or budget. What's holding them back is inefficiency: data that doesn't connect and analysts spending their day hunting for information instead of stopping fraud with modern technology such as AI," said Nuno Sebastião, Co-founder, Chairman, and CEO of Feedzai. "Criminals don't target one bank at a time, so the industry can't defend itself one bank at a time either. The fact that most institutions would consider sharing intelligence with their competitors shows how much has changed in the fight against fraud."
Only a quarter (25.5%) of institutions qualified as “leading” with a readiness score of 76 (out of 100) or higher, reaching the Index's top readiness tier. According to the report, what sets them apart is that they've prioritized connecting their data and freeing up their analysts’ time.
Overall, the industry scores 69.3 out of 100, and 73% of institutions sit in the “Capable” tier (51-75). There are encouraging signs: 68% of institutions are using or planning agentic AI for three or more fraud use cases, though trust in autonomous decision-making is their top concern.

title: LHV Bank Appoints Former Starling Executive Damian Thompson as CEO to Lead Its Next Phase of Growth
summary:
LHV Bank Limited, the UK banking subsidiary of AS LHV Group, has appointed Damian Thompson as Chief Executive Officer and Executive Director. He will join the Bank on 4 January 2027, subject to regulatory approval. He will lead the next stage of growth for the digital-first bank, with a focus on expanding lending, particularly to SMEs.
Damian has more than 30 years of experience across UK banking, structured finance and financial services. After almost 2 decades in senior roles at NatWest Markets, he joined Starling Bank’s executive team, where he was responsible for lending and asset management as the bank scaled. Under his leadership, Starling’s loan assets grew to more than £5bn, largely across mortgages and SME lending. He also served as CEO of Fleet Mortgages, Starling’s buy-to-let lender. He later took responsibility for Starling’s SME banking products, retail overdrafts and loan products.
Until this year, Damian also chaired UK Finance’s Specialist Banks Advisory Forum, which represents banks outside the UK’s big five.
Damian brings more than 35 years of UK banking experience. After almost two decades in senior roles at NatWest Markets, he joined Starling Bank's executive team in 2021, taking responsibility for growth of the lending book as the bank grew from a start-up into one of the UK's leading digital banks. Under his leadership, Starling's loan portfolio grew to more than £5 billion. In 2023, he also became Chief Executive Officer of Fleet Mortgages, Starling's buy-to-let lender.
Mihkel Torim, Chairman of the Board of LHV Bank Limited, commented:  
"Damian knows banking, lending and technology. He combines the experience of one of the UK's largest banks with the pace of Starling, where he led the growth of its lending as it became a major digital bank, and he shares the entrepreneurial spirit that defines LHV. Growing our local presence in the UK on a strong technology platform is at the core of our strategy, and Damian has the experience to lead it."
Damian Thompson, Chief Executive Officer and Executive Director of LHV Bank Limited said:
"LHV Bank has strong foundations for its next phase of growth: advanced technology, the backing of a Group with a sustained record of profitable growth, and a clear ambition to expand its lending. The opportunity to lead a bank with that tech advantage through rapid growth while maintaining the highest standards of risk management and regulatory compliance is compelling. I look forward to working with the UK team and colleagues across the Group to lead LHV Bank into its next chapter."
The appointment is subject to regulatory approval by the Prudential Regulation Authority and Financial Conduct Authority.

title: Social Purpose Fintech Salad Receives King’s Award for Enterprise at Official Ceremony
summary:
Social purpose fintech, Salad, formally received a King’s Award for Enterprise, one of the UK’s most prestigious honours, at an official presentation ceremony with The Lord-Lieutenant of East Sussex, Andrew Blackman CstJ. 
 
Awarded annually by His Majesty The King on the advice of government ministers, the King’s Awards recognise outstanding success and achievement by UK organisations. Salad – which was created to give people underserved by mainstream credit greater access to fair, affordable loans - is the first retail lender to achieve this recognition in the 60-year history of the awards. 
The ceremony took place on Friday 9th October, with the leadership team including Craig Pennington, CEO of Salad; Alan Campbell, Founder of the Salad Group; and Alex Marsh, CEO of the Salad Group. 
 
Salad, which has been in Brighton since 2021 and with a team of over 50, has grown to become the UK’s largest consumer lending Community Development Finance Institution (CDFI). Rather than relying on traditional credit scores, it uses Open Banking to understand real financial behaviour and assess affordability based on someone’s circumstances today. It has now supported more than 200,000 customers, reflecting the growing demand as households continue to navigate financial pressures. 
Craig Pennington, CEO of Salad, said: “We were incredibly proud to learn earlier this year that we had won a King’s Award, so officially receiving it is a major moment for everyone involved in this business. Salad was founded with the ambition to build something truly different, opening access to affordable credit to those not served or underserved by mainstream finance, and the rise in applications we have received from Brighton in the last year shows how much this is critically needed. By looking at people differently Salad has successfully leveraged technology to unlock millions of pounds to help people get on with their lives. This award reflects the talent, commitment and ambition of everyone who has been a part of that journey.” 
Alan Campbell, Founder of the Salad Group, said: “We started Salad because too many people were being turned away by a financial system that didn’t understand them and wasn’t giving them a fair chance. We believed there had to be a better way to assess people and make good lending decisions, and we’ve spent the last eight years proving that. We’ve now lent to more than 200,000 people who mainstream lenders would not have supported. To receive a King’s Award recognising that hard work is a huge honour, and something that I and the whole team at Salad are incredibly proud of.”
The Lord-Lieutenant Andrew Blackman CStJ said: "I am delighted to congratulate Salad Money on receiving The King’s Award for Enterprise for Innovation. As the United Kingdom’s most prestigious business accolade, The King’s Awards recognise organisations that demonstrate outstanding achievement, make a significant contribution through their work, and showcase the very best of British enterprise. My warmest congratulations to everyone at Salad Money on this impressive achievement, of which they should be immensely proud."

content: Social purpose fintech company Salad has officially received the prestigious King’s Award for Enterprise from The Lord-Lieutenant of East Sussex. Operating as a Community Development Finance Institution, Salad uses Open Banking to provide fair and affordable loans to individuals underserved by mainstream credit. The leadership team accepted the honour at an official ceremony, celebrating the company's significant milestone of supporting over 200,000 customers.

Community Development Finance Institution-ஆகச் செயல்படும் Salad, Open Banking-ஐப் பயன்படுத்தி பாரம்பரியக் கடன் வழங்குநர்களால் புறக்கணிக்கப்பட்ட நபர்களுக்கு நியாயமான மற்றும் குறைந்த செலவிலான கடன்களை வழங்கி வருகிறது. 200,000-க்கும் மேற்பட்ட வாடிக்கையாளர்களுக்கு ஆதரவளித்துள்ள இந்த முக்கிய மைல்கல்லைக் கொண்டாடும் வகையில், நிறுவனத்தின் தலைவர்கள் அதிகாரப்பூர்வ விழாவில் இந்த விருதைப் பெற்றுக் கொண்டனர்.

title: Zumo and SaaScada partner for crypto banking
summary:
SaaScada, the cloud-native core banking platform, and Zumo, the UK digital assets platform, today announced a strategic partnership giving UK financial institutions a ready-built route to offering regulated crypto services, alongside the cash accounts used to fund them.
Almost one in 10 UK adults hold cryptoassets, according to the FCA, and the typical value held is rising. Yet most of that activity happens outside the banking relationship, with customers keeping their assets on the exchanges they buy from.
The partnership between SaaScada and Zumo is designed to bring that activity inside banking relationships. Zumo, registered with the FCA as a cryptoasset business, handles the crypto side, from custody and trading to KYC/AML checks. SaaScada runs the cash accounts that fund purchases and receive sale proceeds.
Through the partnership, banks and wealth managers can:
Open a new revenue line and improve client retention by capturing crypto activity that currently happens elsewhere
Launch a regulated crypto offering on infrastructure that is already built and connected, rather than committing to a multi-year build
Give clients one view of their cash and crypto, rather than two disconnected experiences
Track every payment in and out in real time, alongside the rest of the client's banking
Nick Jones, Founder and Chief Executive Officer of Zumo, said: "The UK is bringing cryptoassets within the FCA's regulatory remit, with a comprehensive regime set to take effect in October 2027. This is a game changer for our sector, unlocking pent-up institutional demand and helping the UK build its position as a leading digital assets hub. The question banks and wealth managers are asking has shifted from whether to offer digital assets to how fast they can move."
With just over a year until the new regime takes effect, the partnership is open now to banks, fintechs, neobanks and wealth managers serving UK customers, and is built around each firm's existing proposition rather than offered as a fixed package.
Jones added: "Regulatory developments are baked into our architecture rather than added as an afterthought, which is what an institution needs when it moves on digital assets. Working with SaaScada means a bank or wealth manager can bring regulated crypto services into their proposition without stepping outside the core they've already selected."
Steve Round, Co-founder and President of SaaScada, said: "We do one thing, core banking, and we bring in specialists for everything around it. Zumo has done the regulatory and operational work that lets UK institutions offer digital assets with confidence. For a wealth manager or a bank whose clients are already invested elsewhere, that is the difference between those holdings sitting outside the relationship and becoming part of it."

content: SaaScada, a cloud-native core banking platform, and Zumo, a UK digital assets platform, have announced a strategic partnership. The collaboration allows UK financial institutions, banks, and wealth managers to offer regulated crypto services alongside traditional cash accounts. The integration aims to help institutions capture growing crypto activity, improve client retention, and prepare for upcoming regulatory changes in the UK market.

title: Do Bitcoin ETFs Remove Custody Risk? Analysts Disagree

content: Analysts are divided on whether Bitcoin ETFs eliminate custody risk. While some argue that relying on professional custodians is safer than thousands of amateurs holding their own coins, experts point out that these financial products are still relatively new and have not yet faced a major catastrophe. Furthermore, concerns remain regarding the concentration of assets, as nearly all Bitcoin ETFs currently rely on a single custodian.
content_ta: Bitcoin ETFs custody risk-ஐ நீக்குகிறதா என்பது குறித்து பகுப்பாய்வாளர்களிடையே கருத்து வேறுபாடு நிலவுகிறது. ஆயிரக்கணக்கான தனிநபர்கள் தங்களது கிரிப்டோகரன்சியை பாதுகாப்பதை விட தொழில்முறை கஸ்டடியன்களை நம்புவது பாதுகாப்பானது என்றாலும், இந்த நிதி தயாரிப்புகள் இன்னும் புதியவை என்றும் பெரிய பேரழிவை சந்திக்கவில்லை என்றும் நிபுணர்கள் சுட்டிக்காட்டுகின்றன. மேலும், பெரும்பாலான Bitcoin ETFs ஒரே ஒரு கஸ்டடியனை மட்டுமே நம்பியிருப்பதால், சொத்துக்கள் ஒரே இடத்தில் குவிவது குறித்த கவலைகள் நீடிக்கின்றன.

title: SEC lets a single commissioner form a quorum when the rest are disqualified
summary:

content: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission has updated its quorum rules, allowing a single commissioner to conduct official business if other members are disqualified from participating. This change centralizes regulatory authority and has sparked debates regarding the legitimacy of decision-making processes. Critics are concerned about the implications this shift could have on future enforcement actions and the broader regulatory landscape managed by the agency.
content_ta: U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) தனது கோரம் விதிகளில் மாற்றங்களைக் கொண்டுவந்துள்ளது. இதன்படி, மற்ற ஆணையாளர்கள் பங்கேற்க முடியாத சூழலில், ஒரு ஆணையாளர் மட்டுமே அதிகாரப்பூர்வ முடிவுகளை எடுக்க முடியும். இந்த மாற்றம் ஒழுங்குமுறை அதிகாரத்தை ஒருவருக்குள் சுருக்குவதாகவும், முடிவெடுக்கும் முறையின் நம்பகத்தன்மை குறித்த விவாதங்களை ஏற்படுத்தியுள்ளதாகவும் கருதப்படுகிறது. இந்த மாற்றமானது எதிர்கால அமலாக்க நடவடிக்கைகள் மற்றும் SEC-ன் ஒட்டுமொத்த செயல்பாடுகளில் எத்தகைய தாக்கத்தை ஏற்படுத்தும் என்பது குறித்த கவலைகள் எழுந்துள்ளன.

content_ta: Sharqiya பகுதியில் உள்ள Saudi Aramco தலைமையகத்திற்கு அருகில் வெடிவிபத்து ஏற்பட்டதாக ISNA செய்தி வெளியிட்டுள்ளது. இந்த சம்பவம் பிராந்தியத்தின் ஸ்திரத்தன்மை மற்றும் எரிசக்தி உள்கட்டமைப்பின் பாதுகாப்பு குறித்த கவலைகளை அதிகரித்துள்ளது. இதனால் எரிசக்தி சந்தைகளில் பாதிப்புகள் ஏற்பட வாய்ப்புள்ளதால், பாதுகாப்பு நடவடிக்கைகள் பலப்படுத்தப்பட்டுள்ளன.

title: OpenRouter developers shift to cheaper AI models as prices fall
summary:
OpenRouter data shows 84% of tokens now flow through cheaper non-frontier AI models as token prices fall from $5.63 to $0.21.
The post OpenRouter developers shift to cheaper AI models as prices fall appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Recent data from OpenRouter reveals a significant shift in developer behavior as AI token prices continue to decline. With costs dropping substantially, the majority of traffic has migrated toward more affordable, non-frontier AI models. This trend highlights a growing market preference for cost-effective alternatives over premium frontier models, marking a notable transition in how developers utilize AI infrastructure to build and scale their applications efficiently.
content_ta: AI டோக்கன் விலைகள் தொடர்ந்து சரிந்து வருவதால், டெவலப்பர்களின் பயன்பாட்டில் பெரும் மாற்றம் ஏற்பட்டுள்ளதாக OpenRouter தரவுகள் தெரிவிக்கின்றன. செலவுகள் கணிசமாகக் குறைந்ததால், பெரும்பாலான போக்குவரத்து மலிவான மற்றும் சாதாரண AI மாடல்களை நோக்கி மாறியுள்ளது. இந்த போக்கு, பிரீமியம் மாடல்களை விட செலவு குறைந்த மாற்றுகளுக்கு சந்தையில் வரவேற்பு அதிகரித்துள்ளதைக் காட்டுகிறது. டெவலப்பர்கள் தங்கள் பயன்பாடுகளை உருவாக்குவதில் இந்த மாற்றத்தை ஒரு முக்கிய மைல்கல்லாகக் கருதுகின்றனர்.

title: ECB’s Lane says AI offers growth gains but raises financial risks
summary:
Europe's AI adoption could boost productivity, but success hinges on cross-sector coordination, infrastructure investment, and data interoperability.
The post ECB’s Lane says AI offers growth gains but raises financial risks appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: European Central Bank official Philip Lane notes that artificial intelligence holds significant potential for economic growth and productivity. However, he warns that widespread AI adoption introduces new financial stability risks. Lane emphasizes that capturing these benefits requires improved infrastructure, better data interoperability, and coordinated efforts across various economic sectors to manage potential systemic threats effectively.
content_ta: ஐரோப்பிய மத்திய வங்கியின் அதிகாரி Philip Lane, செயற்கை நுண்ணறிவு (AI) பொருளாதார வளர்ச்சி மற்றும் உற்பத்தித்திறனுக்குப் பெரும் வாய்ப்புகளை வழங்குகிறது என்று குறிப்பிட்டுள்ளார். அதே நேரத்தில், AI-ன் பரவலான பயன்பாடு நிதி ஸ்திரத்தன்மைக்கு புதிய அச்சுறுத்தல்களை உருவாக்குவதாகவும் அவர் எச்சரித்துள்ளார். இந்த தொழில்நுட்பத்தின் பலன்களைப் பெற, முறையான உள்கட்டமைப்பு வசதிகள், மேம்பட்ட தரவு பரிமாற்ற வசதிகள் மற்றும் பல்வேறு பொருளாதாரத் துறைகளுக்கு இடையிலான ஒருங்கிணைப்பு அவசியம் என்று அவர் வலியுறுத்துகிறார்.

title: Anthropic’s Jack Clark takes the AI ‘sudden change’ warning to the IMF
summary:
AI's rapid evolution could significantly impact global productivity and employment, necessitating urgent regulatory measures and oversight.
The post Anthropic’s Jack Clark takes the AI ‘sudden change’ warning to the IMF appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Jack Clark of Anthropic recently addressed the International Monetary Fund to discuss the risks of rapid AI development. He highlighted how sudden shifts in AI capabilities could profoundly disrupt global productivity and labor markets. Clark emphasized the critical need for proactive regulatory oversight and international cooperation to manage these economic impacts, warning that current policies must evolve quickly to keep pace with technological advancements.
content_ta: Anthropic நிறுவனத்தின் Jack Clark, அதிவேக AI வளர்ச்சியால் ஏற்படும் ஆபத்துகள் குறித்து International Monetary Fund-இல் உரையாற்றினார். AI தொழில்நுட்பத்தின் திடீர் மாற்றங்கள் உலகளாவிய உற்பத்தி மற்றும் வேலைவாய்ப்பில் மிகப்பெரிய தாக்கத்தை ஏற்படுத்தும் என்று அவர் எச்சரித்தார். இந்த பொருளாதார மாற்றங்களை நிர்வகிக்க முறையான கட்டுப்பாடுகளும் சர்வதேச ஒத்துழைப்பும் அவசியம் என்றும், தொழில்நுட்ப வளர்ச்சிக்கேற்ப கொள்கைகள் விரைவாக மாற்றப்பட வேண்டும் என்றும் அவர் வலியுறுத்தினார்.

title: Cornell bans fraternity events amid gang rape allegations, investigations ongoing
summary:
Cornell's fraternity event ban highlights institutional accountability and may signal increased legal actions, impacting university policies and perceptions.
The post Cornell bans fraternity events amid gang rape allegations, investigations ongoing appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Cornell University has officially banned all fraternity events following serious gang rape allegations. The university is currently conducting active investigations into the reported incidents. This disciplinary action reflects an increasing institutional focus on student safety and accountability. The university's decision highlights the growing pressure on academic institutions to address misconduct swiftly, potentially setting a precedent for future policy changes and legal scrutiny regarding student organizations on campus.
content_ta: Cornell University-ல் பாலியல் வன்கொடுமை புகாரைத் தொடர்ந்து அனைத்து சகோதரத்துவ (fraternity) நிகழ்வுகளுக்கும் தடை விதிக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது. இது குறித்த விசாரணைகள் தற்போது நடைபெற்று வருகின்றன. மாணவர் பாதுகாப்பு மற்றும் பொறுப்புக்கூறலுக்கு முக்கியத்துவம் அளிக்கும் வகையில் இந்த நடவடிக்கை எடுக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது. பல்கலைக்கழக வளாகங்களில் இதுபோன்ற சம்பவங்களைக் கையாளவும், மாணவர் அமைப்புகளின் மீதான கட்டுப்பாடுகளை வலுப்படுத்தவும் இந்த முடிவு ஒரு முன்னுதாரணமாகக் கருதப்படுகிறது.

title: Can 2026 Be The Year When Ethereum Flips Bitcoin?

While opinions are sharply divided among market experts, the possibility of this milestone remains a major talking point looking ahead toward 2026.
content_ta: Ethereum மற்றும் Bitcoin ஆகியவை மார்க்கெட்டில் மிகப்பெரிய கிரிப்டோகரன்சிகளாக உள்ளன, இதில் Bitcoin முதலிடத்தைப் பிடித்துள்ளது. Bitcoin-ஐ Ethereum பின்தள்ளி சந்தையில் முதலிடத்தைப் பிடிக்குமா என்பது குறித்து பல ஆண்டுகளாக விவாதங்கள் நடந்து வருகின்றன. சந்தை நிபுணர்களிடையே கருத்துகள் வெவ்வேறாக இருந்தாலும், 2026-ம் ஆண்டை நோக்கி இந்த எதிர்பார்ப்பு முக்கிய விவாதப் பொருளாக உள்ளது.

title: Kalshi and Polymarket won’t be part of FTC sports gambling probe, report
summary:
The Federal Trade Commission probe will ignore Kalshi and Polymarket and focus instead on sportsbooks like DraftKings and FanDuel.
The post Kalshi and Polymarket won’t be part of FTC sports gambling probe, report appeared first on Protos.
content: A recent report indicates that the Federal Trade Commission has excluded prediction markets Kalshi and Polymarket from its ongoing investigation into sports gambling. Instead, the regulatory probe will concentrate its efforts on traditional sportsbook operators such as DraftKings and FanDuel. The agency's focus remains on the broader sports betting industry, leaving these prediction platforms outside the scope of the current inquiry.
content_ta: அமெரிக்காவின் Federal Trade Commission மேற்கொள்ளும் விளையாட்டு சூதாட்டம் தொடர்பான விசாரணையில் இருந்து Kalshi மற்றும் Polymarket ஆகிய நிறுவனங்கள் விலக்கப்பட்டுள்ளதாக தகவல் வெளியாகியுள்ளது. இந்த விசாரணை DraftKings மற்றும் FanDuel போன்ற பாரம்பரிய விளையாட்டு பந்தய நிறுவனங்களை மட்டுமே மையமாகக் கொண்டு நடைபெறும் என்று கூறப்படுகிறது. தற்போதைய சூழலில் இந்த முன்கணிப்பு தளங்கள் விசாரணையின் வரம்பிற்குள் வரவில்லை என்பது குறிப்பிடத்தக்கது.

title: Broadcom CEO calls AI ‘a casino’ after co-founder dumped $750 million
summary:
Broadcom CEO Hock Tan accused AI investors of acting “like they are in a casino,” after his co-founder sold $750M of AI stock this year.
The post Broadcom CEO calls AI ‘a casino’ after co-founder dumped $750 million appeared first on Protos.
content: Broadcom CEO Hock Tan recently compared current AI market behavior to gambling in a casino. This observation follows a significant stock sell-off by his co-founder, who liquidated $750 million worth of shares this year. The comments highlight growing investor skepticism regarding the sustainability of the ongoing artificial intelligence market rally, as company insiders begin to reduce their positions despite the industry's rapid expansion.
content_ta: Broadcom நிறுவனத்தின் CEO Hock Tan, தற்போதைய AI சந்தையின் போக்கை சூதாட்ட விடுதியுடன் ஒப்பிட்டு கருத்து தெரிவித்துள்ளார். நிறுவனத்தின் இணை நிறுவனர் இந்த ஆண்டு $750 மில்லியன் மதிப்பிலான பங்குகளை விற்பனை செய்ததைத் தொடர்ந்து இந்த கருத்து வெளியாகியுள்ளது. AI துறையில் முதலீட்டாளர்களின் ஆர்வம் அதிகமாக இருந்தாலும், நிறுவனத்தின் முக்கிய நபர்கள் தங்கள் பங்குகளை விற்பனை செய்யத் தொடங்கியுள்ளது, இந்த சந்தை வளர்ச்சியின் நம்பகத்தன்மை குறித்த விவாதங்களை எழுப்பியுள்ளது.

title: XRPN took shareholder vote with no knowledge of XRP inflation bug
summary:
Evernorth brought millions of XRP to the Nasdaq via XRPN on a fixed-supply thesis that was actually already broken in a secret inflation bug.
The post XRPN took shareholder vote with no knowledge of XRP inflation bug appeared first on Protos.
content: Shareholders of XRPN cast their votes without being informed of a significant inflation bug affecting XRP. The company had previously marketed the asset to investors on the Nasdaq through a fixed-supply premise. However, evidence suggests this supply model was already compromised by a secret technical vulnerability at the time of the vote, leading to transparency concerns regarding how the firm managed its shareholder communications.
content_ta: XRP-ல் இருந்த பணவீக்க பிழை (inflation bug) குறித்த தகவல் தெரியாமலேயே XRPN பங்குதாரர்கள் வாக்களித்துள்ளனர். நிலையான விநியோக முறையைக் கொண்டதாகக் கூறி, Nasdaq-ல் முதலீட்டாளர்களிடம் இந்த சொத்து சந்தைப்படுத்தப்பட்டது. ஆனால், வாக்கெடுப்பின் போது இந்த விநியோக முறை ரகசிய தொழில்நுட்பக் கோளாறால் ஏற்கனவே பாதிக்கப்பட்டிருந்தது தெரியவந்துள்ளது. இது நிறுவனத்தின் வெளிப்படைத்தன்மை குறித்து பெரும் கவலையை ஏற்படுத்தியுள்ளது.

title: 9/11 victims claim bitcoins seized from Chinese-Iranian mining pool
summary:
Victims of the 9/11 terrorist attacks have claimed BTC seized by the US government from the LuBian mining pool.
The post 9/11 victims claim bitcoins seized from Chinese-Iranian mining pool appeared first on Protos.
content: Victims of the 9/11 terrorist attacks have filed legal claims to seize Bitcoin assets confiscated by the United States government. The funds were reportedly linked to the LuBian mining pool, which has faced scrutiny due to alleged associations with Chinese and Iranian entities. The claimants are seeking to recover these digital assets as part of ongoing efforts to satisfy court-ordered damages related to the 2001 attacks.
content_ta: 9/11 பயங்கரவாத தாக்குதலில் பாதிக்கப்பட்டவர்கள், United States அரசாங்கத்தால் கைப்பற்றப்பட்ட Bitcoin சொத்துக்களுக்கு உரிமை கோரியுள்ளனர். இந்த நிதி LuBian மைனிங் பூலுடன் தொடர்புடையதாகக் கூறப்படுகிறது, இது சீன மற்றும் ஈரான் அமைப்புகளுடன் தொடர்பில் இருப்பதாகச் சந்தேகிக்கப்படுகிறது. 2001-ஆம் ஆண்டு தாக்குதல்கள் தொடர்பான நீதிமன்ற உத்தரவுகளின்படி, இழப்பீட்டைப் பெறுவதற்காக இந்த டிஜிட்டல் சொத்துக்களைக் கோருவதாக பாதிக்கப்பட்டவர்கள் தெரிவித்துள்ளனர்.

title: German Ledger reseller pauses sales following $86M draining incident
summary:
Ledger reseller MediaMarkt is no longer selling the wallets following an $86M theft involving tampered devices from Malaysian CryptoBilis.
The post German Ledger reseller pauses sales following $86M draining incident appeared first on Protos.
content: German retailer MediaMarkt has suspended the sale of Ledger hardware wallets. This decision follows a major security incident involving the theft of approximately $86 million in assets. Reports indicate that the breach was linked to compromised devices originating from the Malaysian retailer CryptoBilis. MediaMarkt has removed the products from its shelves to ensure consumer safety while further investigations into the compromised supply chain and security vulnerabilities continue.
content_ta: ஜெர்மனியின் சில்லறை விற்பனை நிறுவனமான MediaMarkt, Ledger வன்பொருள் வாலட்களின் விற்பனையை நிறுத்தியுள்ளது. சுமார் $86 மில்லியன் மதிப்புள்ள சொத்துக்கள் திருடப்பட்ட பாதுகாப்புச் சம்பவத்தைத் தொடர்ந்து இந்த முடிவு எடுக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது. மலேசியாவைச் சேர்ந்த CryptoBilis விற்பனையாளரிடமிருந்து பெறப்பட்ட சாதனங்களில் பாதுகாப்பு குறைபாடுகள் இருந்ததே இந்தத் திருட்டுக்குக் காரணம் என்று கூறப்படுகிறது. நுகர்வோர் பாதுகாப்பை உறுதி செய்வதற்காக, MediaMarkt தனது விற்பனை நிலையங்களிலிருந்து இந்தத் தயாரிப்புகளை நீக்கியுள்ளது. இது தொடர்பான கூடுதல் விசாரணைகள் தற்போது நடைபெற்று வருகின்றன.

title: Microsoft-Owned Ad Firm Hit With Norway’s Biggest-Ever Privacy Fine for Sharing Grindr Users’ Sexual Orientation Data
summary:
An advertising company now owned by Microsoft has been hit with Norway’s largest-ever privacy fine for passing along sensitive data from users of a dating app built for the LGBTQ+ community. The Norwegian Data Protection Authority says it has fined Xandr about $9.6 million for processing and sharing the personal data of Grindr users without […]
The post Microsoft-Owned Ad Firm Hit With Norway’s Biggest-Ever Privacy Fine for Sharing Grindr Users’ Sexual Orientation Data appeared first on The Daily Hodl.
content: Norway’s data protection authority has issued a record-breaking privacy fine to Xandr, an advertising company owned by Microsoft. The penalty, amounting to approximately $9.6 million, was imposed after the firm was found to have shared sensitive personal information, including the sexual orientation of Grindr app users, without proper consent. This enforcement action highlights significant regulatory concerns regarding the handling of sensitive user data by digital advertising platforms.
content_ta: Microsoft நிறுவனத்திற்குச் சொந்தமான விளம்பர நிறுவனமான Xandr-க்கு, நார்வே நாட்டின் தரவுப் பாதுகாப்பு ஆணையம் மிகப்பாரிய அபராதத்தை விதித்துள்ளது. Grindr செயலியைப் பயன்படுத்தும் நபர்களின் பாலியல் நோக்குநிலை குறித்த உணர்திறன் மிக்க தனிப்பட்ட தரவுகளை உரிய அனுமதியின்றிப் பகிர்ந்துகொண்டதற்காக, சுமார் $9.6 மில்லியன் அபராதம் விதிக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது. டிஜிட்டல் விளம்பர நிறுவனங்கள் பயனர்களின் தனிப்பட்ட தரவுகளைக் கையாள்வதில் காட்டும் மெத்தனப்போக்கு மற்றும் பாதுகாப்பு மீறல்களை இந்த நடவடிக்கை வெளிச்சம் போட்டுக் காட்டுகிறது.

content_ta: KuCoin Nigeria நிறுவனம், நைஜீரியாவின் Securities and Exchange Commission-ன் Accelerated Regulatory Incubation Programme-ல் சேருவதற்கான நிபந்தனையுடனான ஒப்புதலைப் பெற்றுள்ளது. இது நிறுவனத்தின் உலகளாவிய இணக்கத்தன்மை முயற்சிகளின் ஒரு பகுதியாகும். எனினும், இந்த ஒப்புதல் தற்காலிகமானது என்பதால், KuCoin தற்போது நைஜீரியாவில் சேவைகளைத் தொடங்கவோ அல்லது புதிய பயனர்களை இணைக்கவோ அனுமதி இல்லை. அந்நாட்டின் ஒழுங்குமுறைத் தேவைகளைப் பூர்த்தி செய்து, தனது செயல்பாடுகளை முறைப்படுத்துவதற்கான பணிகளில் நிறுவனம் ஈடுபட்டுள்ளது.

title: XRP’s 100 Billion Supply Cap Is Safe After RippleX Fixes a Critical XRPL Flaw

content: RippleX has successfully addressed a critical vulnerability within the XRP Ledger. content_ta: RippleX நிறுவனம் XRP Ledger-ல் இருந்த ஒரு முக்கியமான தொழில்நுட்பக் குறைபாட்டைச் சரிசெய்துள்ளது. இந்த நெட்வொர்க்கின் பாதுகாப்பை உறுதிப்படுத்தவும், XRP டோக்கன்களின் விநியோக வரம்பைப் பாதுகாக்கவும் இந்த நடவடிக்கை எடுக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது. இந்த மேம்பாடு லெட்ஜரின் நம்பகத்தன்மையை வலுப்படுத்துவதோடு, டிஜிட்டல் சொத்தின் பொருளாதாரக் கட்டமைப்பில் எந்த பாதிப்பும் ஏற்படாமல் செயல்படுவதை உறுதி செய்கிறது. இந்தச் சீரமைப்புக்குப் பிறகு நெட்வொர்க் செயல்பாடுகளில் எந்தத் தடங்கலும் ஏற்படவில்லை.

content_ta: பிரெஞ்சு வங்கியான Credit Agricole, ஜெர்மன் சந்தையில் தனது சேவையை விரிவுபடுத்தும் வகையில் Credit Agricole Deutschland என்ற டிஜிட்டல் வங்கியைத் தொடங்கியுள்ளது. இந்த புதிய முன்னெடுப்பின் மூலம், ஜெர்மன் வாடிக்கையாளர்களுக்கு பிரத்யேகமான டிஜிட்டல் வங்கிச் சேவைகளை வழங்க அந்நிறுவனம் திட்டமிட்டுள்ளது. ஐரோப்பாவின் மிகப்பெரிய பொருளாதார நாடுகளில் ஒன்றான ஜெர்மனியில் கால்பதிப்பதன் மூலம், தனது சந்தை வாய்ப்புகளை அதிகரிக்கவும் டிஜிட்டல் வங்கித் துறையில் போட்டியை ஏற்படுத்தவும் Credit Agricole முயல்கிறது.

title: Singapore's UOB signs cloud MoU with AWS
summary: Amazon Web Services and Singapore's United Overseas Bank (UOB) have signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) to explore the use of cloud services across the bank's global operations.
content: United Overseas Bank (UOB) and Amazon Web Services (AWS) have signed a memorandum of understanding to advance the bank's digital transformation. The partnership focuses on utilizing cloud computing technologies to enhance operational efficiency across the bank's global network. By leveraging AWS cloud services, UOB aims to streamline its infrastructure and support innovation within its international banking operations, marking a significant step in the financial institution's ongoing cloud adoption strategy.
content_ta: UOB மற்றும் AWS ஆகிய நிறுவனங்கள் வங்கியின் டிஜிட்டல் மாற்றத்தை மேம்படுத்துவதற்காக புரிந்துணர்வு ஒப்பந்தத்தில் கையெழுத்திட்டுள்ளன. இந்த கூட்டணியின் மூலம், வங்கியின் உலகளாவிய செயல்பாடுகளில் செயல்திறனை அதிகரிக்க AWS கிளவுட் சேவைகள் பயன்படுத்தப்பட உள்ளன. AWS கிளவுட் தொழில்நுட்பத்தைப் பயன்படுத்துவதன் மூலம், தனது உள்கட்டமைப்பை நவீனப்படுத்தி, சர்வதேச வங்கிச் சேவைகளில் புதிய கண்டுபிடிப்புகளை ஊக்குவிப்பதை UOB நோக்கமாகக் கொண்டுள்ளது.

title: Fairer Finance and Sideways launch 'michelin star' system for banks
summary: Fairer Finance, the independent consumer group and ratings and research business, and Sideways, the trust-focused behavioural design consultancy, today announce a formal partnership to help retail financial services firms, including banks, insurers and lenders, identify where they are losing customer trust, and fix it before it shows up as a complaint, a regulatory finding, or a customer who simply leaves.
content: Fairer Finance and Sideways have formed a new partnership to help financial institutions enhance customer trust. By combining consumer research with behavioural design, the collaboration aims to help banks, insurers, and lenders identify potential issues before they escalate into formal complaints or customer loss. This initiative intends to improve service standards by proactively addressing weaknesses in the consumer experience, ensuring financial firms can better meet the evolving expectations of their clients.
content_ta: Fairer Finance மற்றும் Sideways நிறுவனங்கள் வாடிக்கையாளர் நம்பிக்கையை மேம்படுத்த புதிய கூட்டணியை உருவாக்கியுள்ளன. நுகர்வோர் ஆராய்ச்சி மற்றும் நடத்தை வடிவமைப்பு ஆகியவற்றின் மூலம், வங்கிகள், காப்பீட்டு நிறுவனங்கள் மற்றும் கடன் வழங்கும் நிறுவனங்கள் தங்களின் குறைபாடுகளை முன்கூட்டியே கண்டறிந்து சரிசெய்ய இந்த முயற்சி உதவும். இதன் மூலம் வாடிக்கையாளர் புகார்கள் மற்றும் வெளியேற்றத்தைத் தவிர்த்து, சிறந்த சேவை தரத்தை உறுதி செய்ய இந்த நிறுவனங்கள் திட்டமிட்டுள்ளன.

title: Caplin Systems appoints CTO
